description: List the schema versions this form has published, newest first (up to 200). Each entry is { id, version, schemaHash, createdAt }. Use it to see when a form's shape last changed — responses reference the version they were collected under. Needs forms:read.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_list_versions
title: List a form's published versions
